help.ntfy_server: ntfy.sh by default, or your own server. ntfy.sh has a daily message quota: Meshloom stops at 200 a day.
help.ntfy_topic: On ntfy.sh the topic is the only secret: topics are public by obscurity, so use a long random one (24 URL-safe characters). Write-only.
help.ntfy_token: For a server with access control. A token wins over a user name and password. Write-only.
help.ntfy_tags: ntfy tags; emoji short codes such as warning show as icons.
help.ntfy_click_url: For example https://meshloom.example.net/ — a tap on the notification opens the conversation.
